title: A microglial basis for fragile X syndrome via impairment of FMRP-regulated lysosomal function
title_zh: 通过FMRP调节的溶酶体功能受损导致的脆性X综合征微胶质基础
abstract: Silencing of the FMRP-encoding FMR1 gene results in fragile X syndrome (FXS), the most common inheritable intellectual disability and autism. FMRP regulates various neuronal functions but clinical trials targeting neurons have failed, suggesting unrecognized disease mechanisms. We find that mice with selective Fmr1 deletion in microglia exhibit audiogenic seizures (AGS) and parvalbumin (PV) neuron loss, recapitulating two key phenotypes observed in FXS (Fmr1−/y) mice. By combining snRNA-Seq and RNA immunoprecipitation, we identify several lysosomal mRNAs as FMRP binding targets. FMRP promotes lysosomal protein expression and its deficiency disrupts lysosomal function in microglia. Notably, FMRP depletion reduces Grn-encoded secretory progranulin and increases PV neuron apoptosis in immature brains. PV neuron density is decreased similarly in Grn+/−, Fmr1−/y, and Grn+/−;Fmr1−/y mice, and progranulin overexpression rescues AGS and PV neuron loss in Fmr1−/y mice. Thus, our study identifies microglia and progranulin as critical regulators of FXS pathogenesis and potential targets for FXS therapy.
abstract_zh: FMR1基因编码的FMRP沉默会导致脆性X综合征（FXS），这是最常见的遗传性智力障碍和自闭症。FMRP调节各种神经元功能，但针对神经元的临床试验已失败，表明存在未被认识的疾病机制。我们发现，小鼠微胶质细胞中选择性Fmr1基因删除会导致音诱发癫痫（AGS）和泡沫蛋白（PV）神经元丢失，这再现了FXS小鼠（Fmr1−/y）中观察到的两个关键表型。通过结合snRNA-Seq和RNA免疫沉淀，我们确定了几种作为FMRP结合靶点的溶酶体mRNA。FMRP促进溶酶体蛋白表达，其缺乏会破坏微胶质细胞的溶酶体功能。值得注意的是，FMRP耗竭会减少编码分泌型前列腺素的Grn，并增加幼年大脑中PV神经元的凋亡。PV神经元密度在Grn+/−、Fmr1−/y以及Grn+/−;Fmr1−/y小鼠中均有降低，前列腺素的过表达可在Fmr1−/y小鼠中恢复AGS和PV神经元丢失。因此，我们的研究确定了微胶质和前列腺素作为FXS病理机制的关键调节因子，并可能成为FXS治疗的潜在靶点。
